title: Why The F And J Keys Have Bumps ⌨️

shots.vo: Look at your keyboard. Two keys have tiny bumps on them. F and J.
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a laptop keyboard showing a small raised bump on a key, shallow depth of field, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Every other key is smooth. So why those two?
shots.prompt: a person's fingertip gently touching a key on a dark keyboard, macro, cinematic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Because that's where your index fingers are supposed to rest.
shots.prompt: two hands resting on a keyboard in typing position, top-down, soft light, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Fast typists don't look at the keys. They feel for those bumps.
shots.prompt: a person typing quickly while looking at the screen, keyboard in the foreground, motion blur, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Once your index fingers find them, every other finger falls into place. That row is called the home row.
shots.prompt: close-up of eight fingers resting on keyboard keys, glowing light on the middle row, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Lift your hands, put them back without looking, and you're instantly right where you started.
shots.prompt: hands hovering above a keyboard in darkness, then landing on the keys, cinematic, vertical composition, dramatic cinematic lighting, highly detailed
shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: You'll find the same trick on the number five, on number pads and phone keypads.

shots.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, brand name

shots.vo: Two tiny bumps. Millions of words typed without looking.
